implementation.basis: Independent observable-ref closures, per-hook membership snapshots and weakly memoized callback adapters. No upstream runtime or declarations copied.
implementation.targetScope: All nine use-callback-ref 1.3.3 exports on React 19, including ref forwarding in react-remove-scroll 2.7.2.

changes: Remove the tslib runtime dependency; React is a peer.
Preserve false, zero and empty-string initial values in useMergeRefs.
Snapshot ref membership so in-place array edits detach removed refs and attach added ones.
Attempt every merged ref update before rethrowing the first callback error.
